folded.into: Architecture Report and the LVT collection

leads.d: “Indus Valley Work Dream” (17 Jan – 1 Feb 2025, 721 messages). The Museum VE, the Lexicon and its gyroscopic core, the seven Rays, the Work Engine and the Dream Engine — and, on 19 Jan, the block formula that became the SmartJournal cover formula.
“Indus Scripts” (12–16 Jan 2025, 847 messages) starts as a blog thread and turns to the script at 21:01 on 12 Jan. Your merchant-logo idea (13 Jan) is the earliest seed of the TAM protocol.

“Cognitive Conceptual Virtual Environment” (1–4 Feb) and “Recursive Intelligence Frameworks” (3–5 Feb 2025): the seed Meta, Morse code, cutting the tether, the 419-symbol lexicon. “LLM Modifications Verification” (4–5 Feb) is o3-mini-high's outside view of the same claims.

The chats report background simulations, iteration counts, match totals (54 → 140 → 312 → 404) and a “95%” lexicon. A chat model does not run between messages; these numbers need checking against the real corpus (CISI, Mahadevan) before the documentary can state them.
CVE (Cognitive Conceptual Virtual Environment) appears in Feb 2025, before EVE and NVE. The April 2025 chat “EVE NVE CVE DCVE” should fix the definitions.
